hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: An element can become a fixed point only if its value does not exceed its original index.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: The number of deletions prior to index i equals the offset i minus nums[i].

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sorting candidates by value and finding the longest non-decreasing deletion chain solves the problem.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Patience sorting with binary search computes the longest valid fixed point chain.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all combinations of deletions is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores candidate pairs and tails array for binary search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transforms the deletion problem into a longest non-decreasing subsequence.
